scientific_question: Does a pre-registered soft integration of MWU and recent mean improve risk-qualified 24-stage Service MSE beyond independently calibrated active strong baselines?

source_evidence.D3f1_new_centers: 59000..59031 EXCLUDED from all new candidate selection and confirm pools
source_evidence.D3f1_false_rejection_warning: Among 470 shadow accepted, p<0.2 would reject 103 beneficial and 65 harmful candidates.

strict_roles.target_M0: once per center+model_seed; shared across streams and arms; 50 warmup updates when not already legally present
strict_roles.candidate: native frozen U_MSE, SGD/MSE 50 steps, lr=0.01, batch64 with replacement, grad_clip=1, identical seed and sampling across arms until trajectories diverge
strict_roles.verification: native Stage3 paired candidate/parent window losses; mean difference + scipy mannwhitneyu(candidate_loss,parent_loss,alternative=less,method=asymptotic); never use Service
strict_roles.service: open only after stage-level action seal; offline calibration/metrics after stage completion
excluded_inputs: stream attack category as decision feature
strict_roles.causal_audit: independent process validates event seals, identity, all numerical gate inputs, state inheritance, source hashes, and all 24 stages before issuing VALIDATED

joint_mechanism.selection_rule: among DEV-qualified lambda>0 options (each-stream risk max, coherent buffer, downside), choose min balanced Service MSE, deterministic tie-break by lower cost, smaller weight, larger margin; lambda=0 is no-increment baseline and cannot claim GO

metrics.primary: mean of clean/mixed lifecycle Service MSE with equal weights per center
metrics.confidence_interval: paired center-cluster bootstrap 4000 draws, original paired center as unit; report not claim guarantees
metrics.cost: end-to-end maintenance runtime+model cache+forward cost; matched measurement scope for baselines

proposed_phases.preflight: asset identity and global center-registry checks; no source changes; pure math test; stage replay and gate score parity

P0.role: software and behavioral smoke only; not model selection
P0.go: audit VALIDATED, at least one action differs vs RecentMean under the fixed P0 settings, all required trajectories complete, each-stream empirical harm<=0.15, candidate balanced MSE<=1.20*P0 RecentMean; smoke resource gate only, not scientific success

DevCal.go: audit VALIDATED, at least one lambda>0 candidate meets all DevCal risk qualifications, is active, improves balanced MSE at least 0.3% versus BEST DevCal risk-qualified ACTIVE strong comparator; else STOP_DEV_CAL; if no active risk-qualified strong comparator then STOP_DEV_CAL (no superiority claim)

Confirm.go: locked candidate risk qualified per stream at 5%, all downside thresholds, balanced MSE at least 0.2% lower than the PRELOCKED best DevCal-qualified active strong comparator, >=4/8 center wins, measured maintenance cost<=2.5 times comparator, audit VALIDATED; else STOP_CONFIRM

ExpandedDev.after: STOP; report negative and positive results; no auto Final or paper edits

new_centers: All phase-specific center IDs must be allocated from full global registry and frozen before any data generation; NO collision or automatic substitution; no reuse of D3f1, D1-D3d, Final or reserved 47000-47015
automated_progress: Local Python process writes progress every 15 min: completed/total trajectories and stages, actual SGD, elapsed, ETA based on observed throughput only, current phase, memory/GPU, exceptions, audit status; Codex need not poll
stage_exit: Any phase with NO-GO stops without retuning, resampling center IDs, or retrying scientific runs; benign resumable engineering exceptions only when exact idempotent receipts checked
not_claimed: D3f1 information GO proves algorithm works
MWU p is a calibrated probability
soft combination is automatically original research
